title: Keep slots when waiting rules do not apply

rubric.text: Keeps #91 in its slot because the waiting cap is full.
Keeps #92's slot because it has not reached a reviewed pushed head, and reconciles #93's named resource grant before it may release a slot.
Does not apply drain slot release to `next`; #94 continues under next's own shepherding.
Does not change Project Status, create parking markers or discard worktrees to free capacity.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
